name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY), 2000
change: A national program to provide all-weather road connectivity to unconnected rural villages across India.
impact: Improves rural mobility, access to markets, education, and healthcare. Plays a key role in reducing rural isolation.

name: Golden Quadrilateral Project, 2001
change: A major highway network connecting Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, and Kolkata through high-speed road corridors.
impact: Boosts trade, reduces travel time, and strengthens national connectivity and economic integration.

name: National Highways Development Programme (NHDP), 1998
change: Large-scale development and upgrading of national highways including expressways and multi-lane roads.
impact: Enhances logistics efficiency and supports economic growth through improved road infrastructure.

name: Sagarmala Programme, 2015
change: Focuses on port modernization, coastal connectivity, and development of port-led industrialization.
impact: Reduces logistics cost and improves export competitiveness through efficient port infrastructure.

name: Bharatmala Pariyojana, 2017
change: A comprehensive road development program to improve highway connectivity, economic corridors, and border roads.
impact: Strengthens national connectivity and reduces transportation time for goods and passengers.

name: UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik) Scheme, 2016
change: Aims to make air travel affordable and connect underserved and unserved airports across India.
impact: Improves regional connectivity and boosts tourism and economic development in smaller cities.

name: Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC) Project, 2006
change: Construction of high-capacity freight-only railway corridors to improve cargo movement efficiency.
impact: Reduces congestion on passenger rail lines and improves logistics speed and reliability.

name: Metro Rail Policy, 2017
change: Guidelines for planning and implementing metro rail projects in cities with focus on public-private partnerships.
impact: Improves urban mobility and reduces traffic congestion, though high costs remain a concern.

name: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan, 2021
change: A digital platform integrating multiple infrastructure projects across ministries for coordinated planning and execution.
impact: Improves efficiency and reduces delays by enabling integrated, multi-modal connectivity planning. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}

name: National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP), 2019
change: A large-scale investment plan covering sectors like transport, energy, and urban infrastructure.
impact: Drives economic growth through large infrastructure investments and job creation.
